english.title: Fishing vessel owner / skipper / employer employ or engage a person under 18 to work on a fishing vessel at night
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[were the owner of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), on board which a person under 18 years of age was employed or engaged to work]_
(B)_[were the skipper of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), on board which a person under 18 years of age was employed or engaged to work]_
(C)_[employed a person under 18 years of age to work on board a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..),]_

at night
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 7(1) and (4) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.

english.notes:
(i) As per paragraph 7(2), this offence does not apply where —

(a) the effective training of the person, in accordance with established programmes and schedules, would be impaired by its application; or
(b) the specific nature of the duty or a recognized training programme requires that the fisherman performs duties at night and the training and the nature of the duties conform to the requirements set out in Merchant Shipping Notice 1882 (F) as not being of detrimental impact to the person's health or well-being.

(i) Regulation 30 provides a defence for the person charged to show that all reasonable steps had been taken by that person to ensure compliance with the provision concerned.
